name: 目录与端点枚举

variants.desc: gobuster 默认字典与线程数
ffuf 随机 UA + 并发降到 10 + 自动校准过滤
variants.command: ffuf -u http://TARGET/FUZZ -w /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/raft-small-words.txt -t 10 -rate 20 -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)' -ac

variants.desc: 只打已知框架路径清单，不发大字典
variants.command: for p in /actuator/env /actuator/heapdump /swagger-ui.html /v2/api-docs /.git/config /console; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} $p\n" http://TARGET$p; done

evasion.traffic: 200 线程的目录爆破在流量侧极其显眼，v2 压到 20 req/s
evasion.artifact: 不落地结果文件到目标侧

notes: 先 v3 打已知路径（几十个请求），命中再考虑 v2 扩字典。
